Job Title: IT Support Engineer to Directors (L1) Experience: 3-4 Years
 Education: B.E. in Computer Science / Telecommunication
 Languages: Marathi, Hindi & English
 Location: Pune
 Employment Type: Full-Time Role Overview We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused IT Support Engineer to Directors (L1) with strong technical expertise in macOS troubleshooting and support , along with hands-on experience with Apple devices such as MacBooks, iPhones, and iPads. The candidate should also possess good knowledge of networking, computer hardware, CCTV systems, and mobile technologies. The primary responsibility of this role is to provide day-to-day technical support to Directors and their family members, ensuring the smooth functioning of IT devices and infrastructure at both office and residential locations. The ideal candidate should have excellent troubleshooting abilities, strong communication skills, and a service-oriented approach. Key Responsibilities Provide technical support for desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and other peripherals. Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and operating system issues for Directors and their family members. Support and maintain Apple devices, including MacBooks, iPhones, iPads, and related applications. Diagnose and resolve network-related issues, including Wi-Fi, LAN, internet connectivity, and VPN access. Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, business applications, and productivity tools. Perform routine system maintenance, software updates, backups, and security checks. Coordinate with internal IT teams and external vendors for issue resolution when required. Escalate complex technical issues to L2/L3 support teams and follow up until closure. Provide Level 1 support for CCTV systems, including monitoring recording functionality and online accessibility. Assist with the setup, configuration, and maintenance of IT infrastructure at Directors' offices and residences. Ensure timely response and resolution of support requests while maintaining high service standards. Maintain proper documentation of incidents, service requests, and IT assets. Required Skills Strong knowledge of macOS administration, troubleshooting, and support . Hands-on experience with Apple ecosystem devices (MacBook, iPhone, iPad, Apple ID, iCloud, etc.). Good understanding of computer hardware, networking, CCTV systems, and mobile technology . Familiarity with Microsoft 365 applications and email configuration. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills. Ability to work independently and handle confidential information with professionalism. Willingness to travel within Pune and visit residential locations whenever required.

title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Job Summary: The Desktop Support Engineer will be responsible for providing technical assistance and support to end-users for hardware, software, and network-related issues. This role involves troubleshooting, resolving, and escalating technical problems to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities: 1. Technical Support: Provide first-level contact and convey resolutions to user issues. Properly escalate unresolved queries to the next level of support. Track, route, and redirect problems to the correct resources. Update customer data and produce activity reports. Document and manage technical issues in the ticketing system. 2. Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues on desktops, laptops, printers, and other peripherals. Perform remote troubleshooting through diagnostic techniques and pertinent questions. Walk customers through problem-solving processes. Collaborate with the network and system administrators to resolve technical issues. 3. Installation and Configuration: Install, configure, and upgrade operating systems and software, using standard business and administrative packages. Install, assemble, and configure computers, monitors, network infrastructure, and peripherals such as printers, scanners, and related hardware. Ensure all installations are done according to company standards and policies. Manage and maintain inventory of hardware and software assets. 4. Maintenance and Monitoring: Maintain records/logs of repairs and fixes and maintenance schedules. Monitor and maintain computer systems and networks. Test and implement new technology. Perform regular system updates and backups to ensure data integrity and security. 5. User Training and Support: Provide accurate information on IT products or services. Guide users with simple, step-by-step instructions. 
 Conduct brief training sessions for users to ensure they understand basic functions and new software updates. Create and maintain user documentation and FAQs. 
 Qualifications: Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 Experience: Proven experience as a Desktop Support Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, or similar role. Experience with Active Directory and network troubleshooting is a plus. Certifications: Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, or similar are preferred. 
 Skills: Excellent problem-solving and multitasking skills. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows OS and Office Suite. Familiarity with remote desktop applications and help desk software. Ability to provide step-by-step technical help, both written and verbal. Strong customer service orientation. Knowledge of Mac OS and Linux is a plus. 
 Soft Skills: Good communication skills. Ability to work independently and within a team. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. High level of patience and empathy when dealing with users. Ability to handle stressful situations and provide calm, professional support. Working Conditions: This role may require working in various shifts to provide support across different time zones. Physical ability to lift and move computer equipment as necessary. Availability for occasional on-call support outside regular business hours. May require travel to different office locations.

Key Skills: Desktop Support,OS Installation,Windows Installation,Hardware Troubleshooting,Hardware Installation,Microsoft Windows,Hardware,Desktop

title: It Support Executive
description:
Job Description 
 IT Support Executive / System Administrator 
 Department: IT & Project Operations
 Location: Pune (Work from Office)
 Reporting To: IT & Project Operations Lead
 About the Role 
We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled IT Support Executive / Junior System Administrator to manage the organization's day-to-day IT operations. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in computer hardware, networking, software installation, IT asset management, user support, and system administration.
The person will be responsible for ensuring uninterrupted IT operations across the office while maintaining proper documentation and IT best practices.

 Key Responsibilities 
 1. IT Asset Management 
 Maintain complete inventory of IT assets. Record issuance and return of laptops, desktops, accessories, and peripherals. Maintain asset lifecycle records. Label and track assets using Asset IDs. Conduct periodic physical verification of assets. Coordinate warranty and AMC records. Manage spare inventory. 
 2. Hardware Support 
 Assemble and configure desktop computers. Diagnose and repair desktops and laptops. Replace hardware components including: RAM SSD/HDD Power Supply Motherboard Keyboard Mouse Display Network cards 
 Perform preventive maintenance. Clean systems and improve performance. Coordinate with OEM service centers whenever required. 
 3. Software Installation & Configuration 
 Install Windows and macOS operating systems. Install office applications and productivity software. Configure email accounts. Install printers and scanners. Install licensed software. Configure antivirus and endpoint security. Perform system updates and driver installations. Maintain software license records. 
 4. User Support (Helpdesk) 
 Provide first-level IT support to employees. Resolve hardware and software issues. Troubleshoot: Printer issues Internet issues Email issues Login issues Application errors 
 Handle employee onboarding and IT setup. Handle employee exit IT activities. 
 5. Network Administration 
 Monitor LAN and Wi-Fi connectivity. Configure routers and switches. Troubleshoot network issues. Manage IP allocation. Coordinate ISP support. Basic firewall administration. Patch network ports. Maintain structured cabling records. 
 6. System Administration 
 Create and manage user accounts. Password reset and account management. Shared folder permission management. NAS/Server access management. Backup monitoring. System health monitoring. Maintain Active Directory (preferred). 
 7. Peripheral Management 
 Printer installation and troubleshooting. Scanner configuration. CCTV basic troubleshooting. Conference room AV setup. Biometric device support. Display and TV installations. 
 8. Documentation 
Maintain updated documentation for:
 Asset Register Software Register Warranty Register Vendor List AMC Records License Records User Allocation Register Network Diagram IP Address Register Service Reports IT SOPs 
 
 9. Preventive Maintenance 
 Monthly system health checks. Disk cleanup. Antivirus updates. OS patching. Hardware inspection. UPS health check. Backup verification. Network device health check. 
 Required Skills 
 Technical Skills 
 Windows 10/11 Administration Basic macOS knowledge Microsoft Office Google Workspace Desktop & Laptop Troubleshooting Hardware Repair Networking Fundamentals TCP/IP DHCP DNS Printer Configuration Router & Switch Configuration Active Directory (Preferred) NAS Management (Preferred) CCTV Basics Basic Firewall Knowledge 
 Soft Skills 
 Good communication Problem-solving attitude Ownership mindset Documentation skills Time management Vendor coordination Team player Ability to prioritize tasks 
 Educational Qualification 
 Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, IT, Computer Science, or equivalent. Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft, Cisco (CCNA), or Google IT Support are an added advantage. 
 Experience 
 25 years in:
 IT Support Desktop Support System Administration Network Support 
 Preferred Experience 
Candidates having experience in:
 Corporate office IT support Multi-office environment IT Asset Management ERP user support CCTV and Access Control systems macOS support Network troubleshooting Vendor management will be preferred.

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 IT tickets resolved within SLA Asset inventory accuracy New employee setup within defined timelines System uptime Network uptime Documentation accuracy Preventive maintenance completion User satisfaction score Zero unlicensed software IT audit readiness 
 Salary Range (Pune Market) 
 ExperienceSalary 23 Years3.0 4.5 LPA35 Years4.5 6.5 LPAStrong System Administrator6.5 8.0 LPA Ideal Candidate Profile 
We are looking for someone who is hands-on rather than purely theoretical a person who enjoys fixing systems, organizing IT assets, supporting users, maintaining documentation, and taking ownership of day-to-day IT operations. The candidate should be reliable, eager to learn, and capable of independently managing routine IT infrastructure while escalating complex issues when necessary.
This role will serve as the first point of contact for all office IT operations and work closely with the IT & Project Operations Lead to ensure smooth, secure, and efficient technology operations across the organization.

Key Skills: Software Troubleshooting,Software Installation,Network Troubleshooting,Hardware Support,Software Support,LAN Troubleshooting,Hardware Troubleshooting,Hardware Installation
